♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: The Moon spends the day in sidereal Sagittarius, your 9th house, in a dharma sign that resonates with exploration, meaning and learning. With the Sun, Mercury and Venus compact in Virgo in your 6th house, there’s a strong contrast between the call of wider horizons and the demand for disciplined work and health routines. Mars, your ruler, continues in Cancer in the 4th, stirring emotion around home and family, while Jupiter and Rahu in Pisces and Virgo activate your 12th–6th axis of service, rest and subtle inner work.

💼 Career: The Virgo stellium in your 6th makes this a solutions day. You can see exactly where a process, schedule or workflow needs tightening, and the Sagittarius Moon helps you grasp the bigger purpose behind those small corrections. It’s a good time to sort out bottlenecks, delegate more intelligently, or finally adopt a tool that makes your daily grind less chaotic. Avoid picking fights over methods; instead, show how a change improves results for everyone.

❤️ Love: With your 9th house lit, you crave partners who share your sense of adventure—intellectual, spiritual or literal. Conversations about beliefs, future travel or study plans can bring you closer. If partnered, the real intimacy comes from revealing what you’re genuinely searching for in life now, even if that’s changed from a year ago. If single, you may feel drawn to people from different backgrounds or those who challenge your assumptions in a refreshing way.

💰 Money: The 6th‑house emphasis links finances to everyday habits. Small leaks—late fees, disorganised bills, health‑related spending you keep postponing addressing—are ripe for correction. Rather than chasing a big win, look at how streamlining work, improving skills or taking on a modest, well‑defined side project could gradually strengthen your income. Avoid impulsive home‑related purchases driven by Mars in Cancer unless they solve a clear, ongoing issue.

🧘 Advice: Let duty and inspiration cooperate instead of compete. Use your urge for a more meaningful life as the fuel to fix the practical details that keep stealing your time and energy.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When your daily actions honour your bigger vision, even routine tasks start to feel like part of a quest instead of a cage.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: Today’s Sagittarius Moon moves through your 8th house, highlighting shared resources, emotional entanglements and deeper psychological layers. The cluster of Sun, Mercury and Venus in Virgo falls in your 5th house of joy, romance and creativity, inviting you to express yourself more freely. Meanwhile, Mars in Cancer in your 3rd makes your words sharp and direct, and Jupiter with Rahu along the Pisces–Virgo axis stimulates your social world and future plans.

💼 Career: This is a day for strategic thinking rather than just ticking tasks off. 8th‑house lunar energy encourages you to examine the back‑end of projects—who controls what, where dependence is high, and which alliances are actually reciprocal. With the Virgo 5th influence, you’re unusually capable of crafting smart proposals or creative solutions that make better use of shared budgets or team talent. Be transparent but measured when discussing sensitive information.

❤️ Love: Emotions run deep, but they don’t have to be heavy. The Virgo 5th house focus wants practical expressions of affection—acts, thoughtful gestures, small rituals—while the Sagittarius Moon pushes for honesty about desire and fears around closeness. If partnered, you might open a conversation about intimacy that mixes warmth with realism. If single, you’re likely to be drawn to people who combine playfulness with emotional depth, not just surface charm.

💰 Money: Shared finances, subscriptions, loans or inheritances can occupy your mind. This is an excellent day to review joint accounts, renegotiate small terms or decide which financial obligations are truly worth maintaining. The 5th‑house support also favours thinking about investments in your talents or in children’s needs. Avoid secrecy around money; clear, kind discussion will protect both your values and your peace.

🧘 Advice: Let curiosity about your own inner workings lead, rather than fear of what you might uncover. Understanding your patterns around trust and resources gives you more freedom, not less.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop treating money and emotions as separate worlds, your choices become both kinder and smarter.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon travels through Sagittarius in your 7th house, throwing a bright light on partners, clients and one‑to‑one dynamics. At the same time, the Virgo trio—Sun, Mercury and Venus—activates your 4th house of home, roots and inner security. Mars in Cancer in your 2nd keeps you motivated around income and self‑worth, while Jupiter with Rahu along your 10th–4th axis stirs questions about career direction versus personal life.

💼 Career: Other people are your mirror today. Feedback from bosses, collaborators or clients can reveal how your professional image has been evolving. The Virgo 4th influence suggests that changing something in your base—your workspace, schedule around home, or emotional attitude toward security—will ultimately support your public role. Be open to renegotiating expectations, especially if current arrangements quietly drain you.

❤️ Love: With the Moon in your partnership house, relationship themes are front and centre. If you’re coupled, you may feel a strong urge to clarify where the two of you are heading, practically and philosophically. This isn’t about ultimatums as much as aligning values and lifestyle. If single, conversations can quickly become more candid than you expect; you’ll likely be turned off by evasiveness, attracted to people who can speak plainly about what they want.

💰 Money: Mars in your 2nd house energises earning potential but can also trigger impulsive spending when emotions run high. The combination of domestic Virgo energy and a relationship‑focused Moon suggests money talks with family members or partners. Approach them with facts and an open mind. You may spot a way to redistribute costs or stabilise a joint plan without feeling restricted.

🧘 Advice: Let today’s dialogues show you where your foundations need an update. When you’re clear about what “home” and security mean now, it’s much easier to choose the right people to build with.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The relationships that last are the ones where both truth and comfort are allowed in the same room.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Sagittarius Moon moves through your 6th house, bringing focus to health, service and daily work. Your ruler, the Moon, here encourages adjustments in routines. Sun, Mercury and Venus in Virgo occupy your 3rd house, sharpening your mind, speech and skills. Mars in your own sign continues to stir courage and reactivity, while Jupiter and Rahu along the 9th–3rd axis pull you between big ideas and the practical steps required to live them.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for organising, planning and communicating clearly. You can turn scattered tasks into a more coherent system, especially if you’re willing to ask specific questions and not assume others know what you need. The 3rd‑house Virgo energy favours drafting documents, refining messages, or learning a tool that makes your workflow smoother. Just be mindful of tone; Mars in Cancer can make you sound more heated than you feel.

❤️ Love: You may feel inclined to show care through practical support—running errands, helping a partner with their schedule, or checking in on their wellbeing. With your 3rd house lit, small gestures and frequent, sincere messages say more than dramatic declarations. If single, you might notice attraction arising in everyday environments—commuting, classes, neighbourhood interactions—where someone’s way of thinking resonates with you.

💰 Money: The 6th‑house Moon encourages you to look at the cost of habits: food, transport, subscriptions, health‑related expenses. Tiny, automatic choices could be shaping your budget more than one‑off purchases. Consider one concrete change that supports both your body and your bank account, such as simplifying meals or consolidating errands. Avoid guilt; focus on gradual improvements.

🧘 Advice: Channel your sensitivity into craftsmanship rather than worry. When you pour your care into how you do things instead of how much there is to do, your nervous system calms down.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The way you handle the small pieces of your day quietly teaches the world how seriously to take your bigger dreams.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through Sagittarius in your 5th house, igniting creativity, romance and a desire for genuine joy. The Sun—your ruler—along with Mercury and Venus in Virgo occupies your 2nd house of values, earnings and self‑worth. Mars in Cancer in your 12th stirs hidden frustrations or old emotional material, while Jupiter and Rahu spanning Pisces–Virgo activate your 8th–2nd axis of shared versus personal resources.

💼 Career: You’re likely to feel more inspired and willing to take initiative on projects that allow a bit of flair or originality. The 5th‑house Moon encourages you to pitch ideas, refine a presentation, or bring fresh life into something that has grown stale. Meanwhile, the Virgo influence on your 2nd house asks you to measure the real value of your efforts: which tasks actually contribute to income or long‑term security, and which simply drain time?

❤️ Love: Fun, warmth and playfulness are highlighted. If partnered, this is a good day to step out of routine and create a shared moment of lightness—anything from an impromptu date to a creative project together. Deeper fears or old disappointments may flicker in the background due to Mars in your 12th, but they don’t have to run the show if you acknowledge them calmly. If single, your charisma rises in spaces where you can express a talent or authentic enthusiasm.

💰 Money: The Virgo stellium in your 2nd rewards a sober look at your financial landscape. You may feel an urge to tidy your accounts, reconsider a luxury expense, or align spending more closely with what truly makes you feel rich inside—skills, experiences, tools—rather than status alone. Supporting a creative pursuit could be worthwhile if it’s built on clear numbers, not wishful thinking.

🧘 Advice: Let pleasure and practicality inform each other. When you respect both what lights you up and what stabilises you, your generosity becomes sustainable instead of exhausting.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The shine that lasts comes from knowing your worth and choosing carefully where you pour it.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Sagittarius Moon travels through your 4th house, turning attention toward home, inner security and emotional ancestry. At the same time, the Sun, Mercury and Venus are all in your own sign, firing up your 1st house of body, identity and immediate choices. Mars in Cancer in your 11th energises friendships and group plans, while Jupiter and Rahu across Pisces–Virgo activate your 7th–1st axis, bringing partnership themes directly to your sense of self.

💼 Career: You’re in a personal re‑calibration phase at work. With so much activity in your sign, you likely feel both more visible and more critical of yourself. Use the 4th‑house Moon to check whether your current professional path actually feels like home to you inside. This is a good day to adjust boundaries around availability, especially with teams or communities that rely heavily on your competence.

❤️ Love: The 7th–1st emphasis makes relationship dynamics vivid. If partnered, you may notice where you’ve been over‑functioning—organising, fixing, anticipating—and feel ready to ask for more mutuality without resentment. Conversations at home can set a new tone if you articulate not just what’s wrong, but what would truly feel supportive. If single, you’re magnetised toward people who respect your need for order yet bring warmth into your emotional space.

💰 Money: The 4th‑house Moon highlights expenses or investments related to housing, family or creating a nest that truly sustains you. With your ruler Mercury in your 1st, you can make sensible decisions today about simplifying, downsizing something that no longer serves, or planning a future improvement step by step. Avoid perfectionism; even one structural change at home can relieve financial and emotional pressure.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to design a life that suits your nervous system, not just your sense of duty. When your inner base is calmer, your natural precision becomes a gift, not a burden.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Saying “this is enough for today” is not laziness for you—it’s how your real strengths stay sharp.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in sidereal Sagittarius lights up your 3rd house of communication, learning and nearby movement. The Virgo cluster of Sun, Mercury and Venus sits in your 12th house, pulling part of your attention inward toward dreams, rest and unfinished emotional threads. Mars in Cancer in your 10th energises career matters but can also stir tension with authority, while Jupiter and Rahu in Pisces–Virgo activate your 6th–12th axis of work and retreat.

💼 Career: You may find yourself juggling visible responsibilities with a strong need for quiet planning time. The 3rd‑house Moon supports writing, calls, outreach and quick problem‑solving, but the 12th‑house Virgo energy asks you to clean up back‑end details and hidden inefficiencies. This is a good day to straighten out old files, clarify boundaries around after‑hours communication, or discreetly reconsider a long‑standing obligation that no longer fits.

❤️ Love: Your inner world is louder than usual. If partnered, you might not feel like putting everything into words right away, but sharing even a little about your current emotional weather can prevent misunderstandings. Short, sincere exchanges—on a walk, in the car, or between tasks—may be more nourishing than intense sit‑down talks. If single, you may notice attraction with someone you meet through local activities or learning, yet your intuition will insist on privacy and pacing.

💰 Money: With Mars at the top of your chart, you may feel pressure to prove yourself financially through career moves. At the same time, the 12th‑house emphasis highlights hidden costs—subscriptions you forgot, fees, or spending tied to fatigue and escapism. Today favours spotting these drains and gently plugging them. You don’t need drastic cuts; a subtle shift in how you soothe yourself can protect your resources.

🧘 Advice: Let your mind move, but give your heart quiet corners. When you honour your need for both connection and solitude, decisions stop feeling like constant compromise.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The conversations that truly matter today are the ones where you’re honest about how much energy you actually have.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Sagittarius Moon moves through your 2nd house, putting focus on security, possessions and the way you value yourself. The Sun, Mercury and Venus in Virgo highlight your 11th house of friendships, networks and long‑term aspirations. Mars in Cancer in your 9th pushes you toward bolder opinions, travel plans or studies, while Jupiter and Rahu in Pisces–Virgo activate your 5th–11th axis of personal joy versus collective goals.

💼 Career: Group projects, alliances and future‑oriented plans are emphasised. You may be asked to take a more strategic role in a team setting or to mentor someone informally. The 2nd‑house Moon urges you to ask: what do I actually gain from this—in skills, reputation or compensation? This isn’t selfishness; it’s aligning your contributions with fair exchange. You might quietly reconsider which collaborations still feel worth the investment.

❤️ Love: Your standards around emotional and practical support are highlighted. If partnered, money and shared logistics might feature in conversations, but the real issue is whether you both feel equally invested in future plans. Honest, non‑dramatic talks about priorities can deepen trust. If single, you may be drawn to someone in your wider social circle who shows reliability and a compatible value system, not just intensity.

💰 Money: Today is ideal for a grounded review of your financial situation. The 2nd‑house Moon supports budgeting, reevaluating recurring expenses, or deciding which material goals actually matter for your sense of stability. With the 11th house lit, think about resources in relation to your long‑term aspirations: are you funding what you say you want, or mostly reacting to the immediate?

🧘 Advice: Let practicality serve your deeper nature rather than dull it. When your material life is aligned with your true priorities, your famous intensity can relax into focus, not control.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Every time you choose to invest in what genuinely matters instead of what merely proves something, you reclaim power.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon is in your own sign today, activating your 1st house and making your moods and instincts more immediate and visible. Sun, Mercury and Venus in Virgo occupy your 10th house of career and public image, putting responsibilities and reputation firmly in view. Mars in Cancer in your 8th stirs deeper emotional and financial themes, while Jupiter—your ruler—moving through Pisces with Rahu’s axis toward Virgo emphasises the tension between home/family and outer achievement.

💼 Career: This is a day when your presence carries extra weight. People are more likely to notice what you initiate, endorse or oppose. With strong 10th‑house Virgo energy, you’re supported in making concrete improvements—clarifying expectations with superiors, restructuring tasks, or setting more realistic timelines. Watch for a tendency to overpromise to feel helpful; it’s better to offer fewer commitments you can fully honour.

❤️ Love: Your need for authenticity is high. If partnered, you may feel called to share how your work pressures are affecting you, or to discuss the balance between professional ambition and shared time. Honest, non‑blaming conversations can realign priorities. If single, you’re more magnetic when you’re simply being yourself, especially in professional or public settings where your competence shows.

💰 Money: The 8th‑house Mars influence draws attention to debts, joint accounts or emotionally loaded financial topics. The current sky doesn’t demand drastic moves, but it does favour taking one courageous step—asking a necessary question, checking terms, or clarifying who is responsible for what. Align money choices with the direction you want your career and life to grow into, not just short‑term relief.

🧘 Advice: Recognise that leadership today starts with leading yourself—your time, your promises, your reactions. When your inner compass is steady, the outer noise feels less binding.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: You don’t have to be everything for everyone; you just have to be consistent with what you say you stand for.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon travels through Sagittarius in your 12th house, inviting withdrawal, introspection and subtle emotional processing. The Sun, Mercury and Venus in Virgo energise your 9th house of higher learning, philosophy and distant horizons. Mars in Cancer in your 7th animates relationship dynamics, while Saturn retrograde in Pisces and Jupiter in Pisces keep your 3rd house of communication under slow, serious review.

💼 Career: This is less about visible breakthroughs and more about clarifying your longer path. The 9th‑house Virgo cluster supports planning for study, certification, travel or a shift in how you apply your expertise. With the Moon in the 12th, you may feel quieter or less inclined to engage with office politics. Use any lull to map where you want to be in a year or three, and what knowledge gap needs bridging to get there.

❤️ Love: Mars in your 7th can heat up interactions—passion or friction, depending on how energy is channelled. At the same time, the 12th‑house Moon suggests you might not fully voice what you’re feeling. If partnered, balance alone time with honest check‑ins, especially around differing beliefs or future directions. If single, you might be drawn to people from different cultures or educational backgrounds, yet part of you needs more time to heal or integrate the past before fully opening.

💰 Money: Financially, today favours reflection over big moves. Consider the long‑term cost or benefit of education, travel, or legal matters rather than chasing quick gains. You might also notice subtle drains—generous habits, supporting others, or escapist spending—that no longer feel sustainable. A gentle boundary can protect your resources without shutting your heart.

🧘 Advice: Accept that not every important step is visible from the outside. Quiet days where you question your direction and beliefs are exactly where your next solid chapter begins.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Resting while you rethink your path is not falling behind; it’s refusing to climb the wrong mountain out of habit.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Sagittarius activates your 11th house of friends, community and aspirations. The Virgo grouping of Sun, Mercury and Venus lights up your 8th house, drawing attention to deeper bonds, shared resources and inner transformation. Saturn, your traditional ruler, is retrograde in Pisces in your 2nd, keeping financial and self‑worth themes under sober scrutiny, while Jupiter and Rahu’s axis across Pisces–Virgo further intensify the 2nd–8th dynamic.

💼 Career: Networking and group efforts are significant today. You may see more clearly which alliances support both your ideals and your practical needs, and which leave you carrying hidden burdens. The 8th‑house Virgo influence is excellent for tackling complex matters at work—budgets, contracts, restructuring—where transparency and precision are needed. Don’t shy away from uncomfortable questions; just deliver them with calm respect.

❤️ Love: Intimacy, in all senses, is highlighted. If partnered, this can be a day to talk about long‑term plans involving shared finances, emotional labour, or even secrets that have subtly shaped the relationship. Approached with curiosity rather than accusation, such talks can deepen trust. If single, you may feel attracted to people who are a bit unconventional but emotionally honest. Friends or social causes may provide the bridge to deeper connections.

💰 Money: With both your 2nd and 8th houses activated, financial interdependence deserves attention. This could involve loans, insurance, investments, or simply how much you share and where you need firmer boundaries. Today is well suited to recalculating, consolidating or simplifying rather than taking big risks. Clarifying your own values around money will make decisions with others far easier.

🧘 Advice: Let your instinct for fairness extend inward. You are allowed to ask whether the exchanges in your life—emotional, financial, energetic—are genuinely mutual.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you stop agreeing to lopsided deals, you create space for connections that respect both your heart and your effort.
pisces:
♓ Pisces

🔥 Energy: The Sagittarius Moon moves through your 10th house, highlighting career, visibility and responsibility. Sun, Mercury and Venus in Virgo energise your 7th house of partnerships, contracts and key one‑to‑one bonds. Jupiter, your ruler, continues in Pisces in your 1st, quietly expanding your sense of self, while Saturn retrograde in your sign adds a sober, maturing tone to who you’re becoming.

💼 Career: Today’s sky puts you on stage. Decisions and interactions linked to your professional life carry extra weight. The 7th‑house Virgo emphasis favours collaborations based on clear roles, realistic timelines and mutual respect. You may renegotiate a contract or refine an agreement so it truly reflects the work involved. Notice who meets your clarity with their own, and who avoids specifics.

❤️ Love: Partnership themes are strong, whether romantic or business. If coupled, you may be prompted to look at the practical side of your bond—division of responsibilities, how you support each other’s ambitions, and what needs updating. This doesn’t have to be heavy; small adjustments can make both of you feel more seen. If single, you could encounter someone through work or formal settings who mirrors the kind of adult, grounded connection you’re now ready for.

💰 Money: The 10th–7th focus suggests that your finances are closely tied to how you collaborate and what roles you accept. This is a good day to review terms, rates or expectations with clients and partners, and to ask yourself whether you’ve been under‑valuing your contribution. Saturn in your sign supports taking a measured, long‑term view rather than chasing quick fixes.

🧘 Advice: Stand gently but firmly in the version of yourself you’re growing into. You don’t need to dramatise your boundaries; you only need to hold them consistently.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The more you structure your compassion with clear agreements, the more your kindness becomes a strength instead of a drain.
